pattern.name: sitemap_xml_structure
pattern.description: XML sitemap for comprehensive site indexing
pattern.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9"> <!-- Homepage --> <url> <loc>{{base_url}}/</loc> <lastmod>{{current_date}}</lastmod> <changefreq>daily</changefreq> <priority>1.0</priority> </url>
<!-- Important pages --> <url> <loc>{{base_url}}/about</loc> <lastmod>{{last_modified_date}}</lastmod> <changefreq>monthly</changefreq> <priority>0.8</priority> </url>
<!-- Blog posts/articles --> {{#each blog_posts}} <url> <loc>{{base_url}}/blog/{{slug}}</loc> <lastmod>{{modified_date}}</lastmod> <changefreq>weekly</changefreq> <priority>0.7</priority> </url> {{/each}}
<!-- Product/Service pages --> {{#each products}} <url> <loc>{{base_url}}/products/{{slug}}</loc> <lastmod>{{modified_date}}</lastmod> <changefreq>monthly</changefreq> <priority>0.6</priority> </url> {{/each}} </urlset>

pattern.name: critical_css_injection
pattern.template:
<style>
/* Critical CSS for above-the-fold content */
.critical-above-fold {
  /* Hero section */
  .hero { display: block; }
  .hero h1 { 
    font-size: 2.5rem; 
    line-height: 1.2; 
    margin-bottom: 1rem; 
  }
  .hero p { 
    font-size: 1.1rem; 
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem; 
  }
  
  /* Navigation */
  .nav { display: flex; }
  .nav-item { 
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem; 
    text-decoration: none; 
  }
  
  /* Critical buttons */
  .cta-button {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    background-color: #007bff;
    color: white;
    text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
// Critical CSS injection for performance
(function() {
  var css = document.querySelector('.critical-above-fold').textContent;
  var style = document.createElement('style');
  style.type = 'text/css';
  style.appendChild(document.createTextNode(css));
  document.head.appendChild(style);
})();
</script>

pattern.name: google_analytics_4_setup
pattern.description: Google Analytics 4 with enhanced ecommerce and SEO tracking
pattern.template:
<!-- Global site tag (gtag.js) - Google Analytics -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id={{measurement_id}}"></script>
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());
  
  gtag('config', '{{measurement_id}}', {
    page_title: document.title,
    page_location: window.location.href,
    content_group: '{{content_category}}',
    custom_map: {
      'custom_dimension_1': 'author_name',
      'custom_dimension_2': 'content_category',
      'custom_dimension_3': 'target_keyword'
    }
  });
  
  // Enhanced ecommerce tracking
  gtag('config', '{{measurement_id}}', {
    currency: '{{currency_code}}',
    send_page_view: false
  });
</script>

<!-- SEO performance tracking -->
<script>
// Track Core Web Vitals
function trackCoreWebVitals() {
  gtag('event', 'core_web_vitals', {
    'event_category': 'Performance',
    'custom_parameter': 'LCP'
  });
}

// Track search rankings
function trackKeywordRanking(keyword, position, url) {
  gtag('event', 'keyword_ranking', {
    'event_category': 'SEO',
    'custom_parameter': keyword,
    'value': position
  });
}

// Track organic traffic
function trackOrganicTraffic(source, medium, campaign) {
  gtag('event', 'organic_traffic', {
    'event_category': 'Acquisition',
    'event_label': source + '/' + medium
  });
}
</script>
